title: Seeding Assay for Cell Lines
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Set protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Enter the desired parameters (e.g., number of cell lines, replicates) in the protocol interface.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the provided protocol file and unzip it if it is compressed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware definitions
steps.instruction: Add your custom labware to the OT App.

substeps.instruction: Navigate to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware
Select the labware JSON files (.json) and upload them

steps.title: Upload protocol script
steps.instruction: Load the protocol script into the OT App.

steps.title: Arrange deck per map
steps.instruction: Place the required labware on the robot deck exactly as shown in the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Run the calibration routine in the OT App to calibrate labware, tip rack, and pipette.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press the Run button to execute the protocol.
